default_protocol.description: Default protocol used when no protocol is specified in URL; must be one of ftp, ftps, ssh, local, bookmark

port.description: Global default port override; 0 means use protocol default

proxy_host.description: Hostname of the proxy server to use for transfers

proxy_port.description: Port number of the proxy server; 0 means use default proxy port

show_local_time.description: If true, display remote timestamps in local timezone instead of remote timezone

show_hidden_files.description: If true, show hidden files (those starting with .) in directory listings

bookmarks.description: List of pre-configured bookmark connections; each item defines a bookmark entry
